facts.fact: Clare 与 Celia Attley 在 Heaven on Seven 餐厅吃午饭，地点在 Garland Building 七楼、Celia 办公室附近。
facts.anchor: I’m having lunch with Celia Attley at Heaven on Seven

facts.fact: Celia 刚拿到 LSW，取得伊利诺伊州社工执照，这顿饭是为她庆祝。
facts.anchor: Celia just received her LSW, and she is now licensed

facts.fact: Celia 直接质问 Clare 为什么爱着 Beck，并说自己才是那个一直在等她的人。
facts.anchor: Why are you in love with that Becky Charles? I’m the one

facts.fact: Celia 说爱有许多种，一口气列出 eros、philia、agape、ludus，断言 Clare 与 Beck 之间有别的什么。
facts.anchor: There’s all kinds of love: eros, philia, agape, ludus

facts.fact: Celia 追问 Beck 到底有什么是她没有的，Clare 只答「她让人安宁」。
facts.anchor: What’s she got that I haven’t got?” Celia demands.

facts.fact: Celia 半开玩笑地说，也许这个 Beck 会让她心碎一点，那对她反而是好事。
facts.anchor: Maybe this Becky Charles will break your heart a little

facts.fact: 分别后 Clare 看着 Celia 穿过 Wabash 街，她一顿一顿的步态让那个瘦小身影在人群里很好认。
facts.anchor: her halting gait makes it easy to pick out her slight figure
